title: AgentSelect: Benchmark for Narrative Query-to-Agent Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2603.03761v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM agents are rapidly becoming the practical interface for task automation, yet the ecosystem lacks a principled way to choose among an exploding space of deployable configurations. Existing LLM leaderboards and tool/agent benchmarks evaluate components in isolation and remain fragmented across tasks, metrics, and candidate pools, leaving a critical research gap: there is little query-conditioned supervision for learning to recommend end-to-end agent configurations that couple a backbone model with a toolkit. We address this gap with AgentSelect, a benchmark that reframes agent selection as narrative query-to-agent recommendation over capability profiles and systematically converts heterogeneous evaluation artifacts into unified, positive-only interaction data. AgentSelectcomprises 111,179 queries, 107,721 deployable agents, and 251,103 interaction records aggregated from 40+ sources, spanning LLM-only, toolkit-only, and composition

translated_title: AgentSelect：面向叙述性查询到智能体推荐的基准测试
translated_abstract: LLM智能体正迅速成为任务自动化的实用接口，然而该生态系统缺乏一种在快速膨胀的可部署配置空间中进行选择的原则性方法。现有的LLM排行榜和工具/智能体基准测试只是孤立地评估各个组件，并且在任务、指标和候选池之间仍然碎片化，留下了一个关键的研究空白：几乎没有基于查询条件的监督数据来学习推荐将骨干模型与工具包相结合的端到端智能体配置。我们通过AgentSelect来填补这一空白，该基准将智能体选择重新构建为基于能力档案的叙述性查询到智能体的推荐问题，并系统地将异构的评估产物转换为统一的、仅含正样本的交互数据。AgentSelect包含来自40多个数据源的111,179条查询、107,721个可部署智能体和251,103条交互记录，涵盖仅LLM型、仅工具包型以及组合型……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: AgentSelect是一个将智能体选择重新建模为“叙述性查询到智能体推荐”任务的基准，聚合了超过11万条查询、10.7万个可部署智能体和25万余条交互记录，填补了端到端智能体配置推荐缺乏查询条件监督数据的研究空白。
en_tdlr: AgentSelect is a benchmark that reframes agent selection as narrative query-to-agent recommendation, aggregating over 111K queries, 107K deployable agents, and 251K interaction records to fill the critical gap of query-conditioned supervision for recommending end-to-end agent configurations.
